text: home dashboard (10-3): new repo ~/Documents/GitHub/home, built in its own session from BRIEF.md. Phase 1 is the Now strip only, from coter-kit's live status files, the brain and GitHub via gh. State comes from plain code (models only for actions, Claude Max first). No git push for live state. Tailscale plus a webhook secret

coter-kit: add a machine-wide lock around brain syncs and your-time beats? Codex asked in rounds 2 and 3. Without it nothing is lost (a note waits for the next sync, a race needs two messages within milliseconds), and reports are now truthful. With it: about 30 lines built on git's update-ref, plus stale-lock handling. My pick: not now; revisit if /brain ever shows sync failures
LOCK-1: no machine-wide lock for brain syncs or beats for now; revisit if /brain shows sync failures (owner agreed 10-3)
M5 phone pushes: a simple watcher reads the live status files and pushes through ntfy, no model credits; only it pushes (owner 10-3)
coter-kit 0.9.0 ships after the first outside-review arc (RV-001 to RV-004, 28 findings all fixed); the owner closed it: enough iterating, move forward unless a true blocker
Move forward once there's no true blocker: past a point, more iterating costs more than it finds
